page: Amazon Web Services c8in.96xlarge is a compute-optimized instance built on the AWS Nitro hypervisor architecture. The platform is driven by Intel x86_64 processors clocked at 3.9 GHz, offering 192 physical cores and 384 dedicated virtual CPUs via two threads per core. System memory is configured at 768.0 GB, which establishes a 2.0 GB memory-to-vCPU ratio aligned with standard compute-intensive provisioning.

Network infrastructure is a prominent characteristic of this server type, featuring a baseline network bandwidth of 600 Gbps to support extreme communication throughput. The instance includes no onboard local storage, necessitating reliance on network-attached storage solutions for all persistent file systems. Furthermore, the configuration does not incorporate discrete GPU accelerators.

The hardware composition provides an efficient profile for scaling large computational jobs across high-bandwidth networks without requiring local drive maintenance. Primary workload fits include high-performance computing (HPC) nodes, distributed simulations, batch processing clusters, and network-bound video encoding or media processing pipelines.
